Three validity findings: (1) existence/duplicate confirmed with caveat -- P3990/P3991/P3992 are NOT duplicates (P3990 is a large federal Du720mm bypass trunk; P3991/P3992 map to separate, smaller GRS offtake items -- 269 Pazhga, 266 Vizinga -- actually found in 3326-r's annex); (2) classification concern -- PipelineType should be transmission, not distribution (federal-significance branch pipeline, Du720mm, statutory 25m/150m protection zones); (3) spec concern -- ProposalYear should be 2016 (earliest documented proposal/agreement), not 2021. Status review: verdict=change, proposed_status=construction (not yet operating -- final hydraulic-testing/nitrogen-fill stage per a 2026-06-10 Wayback capture, gas not yet introduced), evidence_date 2026-06-10. Two cross-row leads staged for P3991/P3992 naming their likely correct decree items.
